reports.notes: Doesn't start, crashes steam big picture, but big picture reloads
Installs the needed Visual C++, but doesn't launch, completely crashes Mihawk OS

Games need to be transferred to the same location as on PC. Registry keys need to be set like in Linux setups. Only works when started over the Mihawk Desktop. Direct launcher crashes the game

Game.js needs to look like this:

{
"arguments": "konaste.bomber-girl://login?tk= ",
"detail": "Launcher manual URL-Token",
"directory": "C:\\Games\\BomberGirl\\launcher\\modules",
"env": [
"LC_ALL=ja_JP.UTF-8",
],
"executable": "C:\\Games\\BomberGirl\\launcher\\modules\\launcher.exe",
"name": "Bombergirl (Token-Login)",
"prefix": "mihawk"
}

Token can then be manually edited over the webbrowser while in launcher. Token can be exctracted from inspecting the "launch game" button on the website.

Game runs fluently most of the time, loading inbetween menus etc. lags a bit. Online play should work, didn't test yet. Mihawk OS lacks a capability to create a wrapper and to launch the game over the konami website after login. So maybe at some state it's easier to launch.
